item.title: Group requests stay with the intended audience
item.summary: When a group message asks someone's personal Murph for help, the result returns to the group unless that exact message explicitly requests a private reply.
item.details: Conflicting audience intent shares nothing. A private request needs a current same-channel direct route before personal work starts. If that route later disappears, the group receives only a non-disclosing unavailable result; the private answer never falls back.
